name: topo-wars
features: Find me or a picked place turns real map roads, buildings, water and elevation into the battlefield.
Setup picks map size 32, 64 or 128, opponent computer, friend, zombies or watch, player count and difficulty.
Turns deploy units with supply, move and attack, with undo this turn and end turn.
Units capture, wreck and encircle, and losing the commander eliminates a side.
Game guide and battle history open, and friend games join by code.
